description: A dim, oil-painted scene of a shallow pit lit by torches. A woman in a dark garment lies on her back, covered in gold necklaces, coin discs, bangles and a belt with gold plaques and animal figures. Two bearded men in fur-like clothing kneel at the pit edge, one reaching toward a gold ring. A gold rod lies beside her, with dark ceramic pots nearby. Beyond are cliffs and a grey sea under a dusky sky. No visible text, no frame, and nothing gory.
